Tests and benchmarks lthash adder push, Solana account push, and flush against a reference hash.

# Purpose
This file contains test and benchmark code for `fd_lthash_adder`, which updates a long-term hash value from input data. The [`test_lthash_adder`](<#test_lthash_adder>) function checks object creation and deletion, then runs many random cases to compare `fd_lthash_adder_push`, `fd_lthash_adder_push_solana_account`, and `fd_lthash_adder_flush` against a reference hash built with `fd_blake3` and `fd_lthash_add`. It uses random input sizes and data patterns to verify that the adder output matches the reference result after each update or flush. The [`bench_lthash_adder`](<#bench_lthash_adder>) function measures hash throughput for repeated 128-byte inputs and logs the time per hash and hashes per second.
